title: crepis foetida subsp. commutata
intro: Crepis foetida subsp. commutata, commonly known as Stinking Hawk's Beard, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Crepis foetida subsp. commutata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
